about: Golden GLiNER spans for piece K (docs/33 §5.3, §5.4). Offsets index the NFC text of texts.json: start/end in code points, start_byte/end_byte in UTF-8 bytes. 'torch' is the PyTorch reference on the source weights; each 'onnx_*' is the Python gliner pipeline on that exported file with ONNX Runtime. K matches the variant the bundle ships (tools/ml/models.toml). onnx_inputs are the exact feeds of the fp32 run (every variant takes the same feeds).
